Reasoning: This release stage is encoded conjunctively. freeze_position holds the panda_fingertip origin at its stage-start position within the requested 0.01 m tolerance. freeze_orientation holds the current panda_fingertip quaternion/orientation fixed without adding any new axis relationship. open_gripper represents simultaneous commanded opening of both gripper fingers and the success condition that the gripper is open. I did not emit object_grasped because the stage requires loss of grasp, and the API has no negated object_grasped term. The requested reduction of opposing finger contact/effort cannot be represented directly because available condition labels only include manipulator arm/TCP effort, not finger squeeze effort. Holding both top_drawer_handle_frame and top_drawer_center_frame fixed during release also cannot be fully represented because the stage already requires the single allowed position op for the panda_fingertip, and freeze_position does not support multiple object frames here.
